item.title: Top Pick: Chipotle: National Quesadilla Day: Free Quesadilla with a $20 Digital Order, Code NQD2026
item.description: Thursday and Friday (September 24 to 25): add a free quesadilla entree to any Chipotle app or chipotle.com order of $20 or more with code NQD2026 at checkout. Open to everyone, no Rewards account needed. Digital orders only: not valid in restaurant or on delivery apps; no add-ons on the free quesadilla; one per order while supplies last. (Through September 25, 2026)
